searchText: where in the specs can I find the planned shard count and total data bandwidth? Is there anything formal for bandwidth? https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/HkiULaluS Vitalik details it mildly at the top here You can back into bandwidth with slot time, shard blocks per slot (shard count), and shard block size Latest numbers from memory are 2.8Mb/s but we should double check yeah, I remember that doc from Devcon. was any of that decided/formalized, or is it still a proposal? Those estimates are still valid, but final numbers won't be available until phase 1 implementations have been tested on live networks
